 HoopsHype Oct. 20, 2026, 4:40 a.m. ET Trae Young: "I'm definitely focused on our identity and making sure that the Wizards is a brand you look at in a positive way. You want the Wizards to have that same type of feeling and DC is a basketball city at heart with a bunch of other great sports around it. So yeah, for me, I just want the culture to be back to what it is and what it used to be. Yeah, you definitely see the energy shifting, you definitely feel the vibe and everything and everything shifting around the city, but it's not just because of me. It's because of this whole team, this whole organization and what they've been building these last few years. This is just a great opportunity for me and everybody around me, like my teammates, and just to take advantage of it and because if we win the city, the city's going to be up."
